text_block_list.name: Party Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Rose Kingdom,
my heartfelt congratulations on your
victory.
Your command of the race was truly
exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Party Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Exhibition race though it was,
to run like that against such a field of
seasoned greats.
The future of the Rose Clan looks bright
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am honored.
I shall continue to forge ahead together
with him.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am honored.
I shall continue to forge ahead together
with her.

text_block_list.name: Party Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you are Lady Rose's trainer.
Standing alongside the Rose,
like a faithful retainer serving their
monarch.
choice_data_list: Yes, I will support you with all m...

text_block_list.name: Party Guest A
text_block_list.text:
You are most dependable indeed.
To our future kingdom,
where roses shall bloom in glory—cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This is a system monologue.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...You seem to have grown quite accustomed
to high society yourself.
choice_data_list: For I have walked through countles...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As her race record built up and attention
grew,
such opportunities only became more
frequent.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to our continued work
together.
choice_data_list: Yes, I shall support you with all ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Invited by a noble lady met in high society
to a botanical garden—
the two of us stroll through it together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The meticulously tended, lush blooms
truly brought solace to the hearts of all
who beheld them.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Quite magnificent.
It must be painstakingly maintained.
choice_data_list: Those roses over there are particu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I marveled at the crimson garden sprawling
before me,
a single vibrant rosebush suddenly caught
my gaze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blooming with a proud, dignified grace,
it radiated a beauty in a class of its
own—
subtly reminiscent of Rose Kingdom walking
beside me.
choice_data_list: (...I, too, will make our rose bloom.)
(...I, too, will make our rose bloom.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill her long-held wish,
I must stake my very being and carry out
this mission to the end.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...How unusual.
For them to show such intense interest.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Did that rose capture their heart so deeply,
I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To bring some enrichment to his personal
life...
Yes, I had often thought of doing so,
but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To bring some enrichment to her personal
life...
Yes, I had often thought of doing so,
but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —With this, surely...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There's a place I'd like to drop by.
Sorry,
but would you head back ahead of me?
choice_data_list: If you are going shopping, I would...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, extra hands are unnecessary.
It may take some time.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you. ——...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
If it pleases you,
I would like you to have this.
choice_data_list: Could this be... the rose from tha...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I received it from the gentleman who
bred it.
He told me that if you cut a stem and place
it in water, it will sprout roots.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Diligent as you are,
you will surely cultivate it into a magnificent
plant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprised by the unexpected gesture,
I accept the rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. No matter how many times I behold it,
it is magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that back then,
she too was drawn to this rose?
Perhaps she felt it was a flower truly
befitting the Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then this must be an imperial decree—
to cultivate a garden of roses that will
grace the kingdom
when that cherished dream is at last
fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...What do you think?
Care to try cultivating one?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...!
I see.
Then devote yourself to it with all your
heart.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Good. It seems you enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(With this,
he should now be able to use his leisure
time for himself.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(With this,
she should now be able to use her leisure
time for herself.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(As their liege,
was I able to reward them even in some small
measure?)
